wallet_card_credit.description: Default name for a credit card. Network is an untranslated brand such as Visa.

wallet_card_debit.description: Default name for a debit card. Network is an untranslated brand such as Mastercard.

wallet_card_fallback.description: Saved card name when its network is unknown and it has no explicit name.

wallet_card_prepaid.description: Default name for a prepaid card. Network is an untranslated brand such as American Express.

wallet_contact_changed.defaultMessage: உங்கள் தொடர்புத் தகவல்கள் மாற்றப்பட்டுள்ளன. தொடர்வதற்கு முன் அதை மீண்டும் ஏற்றவும்.
wallet_contact_changed.description: The default contact profile changed during enrollment, requiring an explicit reload.

wallet_contact_load_error.defaultMessage: உங்கள் தொடர்புத் தகவல்களை ஏற்ற முடியவில்லை. மீண்டும் முயலவும்.
wallet_contact_load_error.description: Contact info failed to load before card enrollment.

wallet_contact_save_error.defaultMessage: உங்கள் தொடர்புத் தகவல்கள் சேமிக்கப்பட்டனவா என்பதை உறுதிப்படுத்த முடியவில்லை. சரிபார்த்துத் தொடர, மீண்டும் முயலவும்.
wallet_contact_save_error.description: Contact info save failed or its outcome is uncertain. Retrying checks current data before saving again.

wallet_enrollment_add_card_action.description: Enrollment elicitation action when Wallet already has a saved card.

wallet_enrollment_load_error.description: Native enrollment action error when Wallet inventory could not be read.

wallet_enrollment_set_up_action.description: Enrollment elicitation action when Wallet has no saved card.

wallet_enrollment_title.description: Native sheet title shown while the secure Wallet card enrollment form loads and remains open.

wallet_enrollment_unavailable.description: Disabled enrollment elicitation label when Wallet is unavailable for the account.

wallet_summary_coming_soon.description: Customize Wallet row value before Wallet is enabled.

wallet_summary_error.description: Customize Wallet value when an initial or explicitly requested read fails.

wallet_summary_loading.description: Customize Wallet value before the first inventory read completes.

wallet_summary_set_up.description: Customize Wallet row value when Wallet needs connection or has no saved cards.

wallet_summary_unavailable.description: Customize Wallet value when Wallet is unavailable for the account.
